gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Default Redis URL points to database index 1
gotchas_discovered.details: REDIS_URL defaults to redis://127.0.0.1:6379/1 instead of index 0, which may differ from standard Redis installations
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Ensure environment variable REDIS_URL is properly configured in production

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Fixed socket timeout may be too aggressive
gotchas_discovered.details: SOCKET_CONNECT_TIMEOUT and SOCKET_TIMEOUT both set to 5 seconds - may cause timeouts under high load
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Monitor actual timeout occurrences in production and adjust if needed

gotchas_discovered.details: May need adjustment based on actual concurrent request patterns and server capacity
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Performance test under expected load and adjust max_connections accordingly
